thread:
hannah-sales: Quick presales sync for Pelotonix. They want enterprise commit guidance. Traffic: steady 6 rps, daily tokens ~1.6M, spikes to 50 rps for 5-12m twice/day. SLO: 99p < 320ms for short (<64t). They ask for reserved GPU suggestion, autoscale, prewarm/KV, and a note for pricing uplift.

raj-eng: clarifying: single region? model? any heavy decoding jobs scheduled?

hannah-sales: yes single region (eu-west-1). They'll use redwood-mistral-7b for chat; nightly analytics jobs cause decoding-heavy long requests.

carmen-se: Recommend baseline: 2 x A100-80GB reserved for steady short chat latency, +1 reserved prewarm slot (pinned weights + KV). Autoscale: allow up to +3 burst GPUs (on-demand/spot mix) for spikes. Prewarm top_180 prefixes and pin to prewarm slot.

leo-infra: ops caveats:
- Spread reserved across 2 AZs (2/1).
- Burst can use spot with route-to-quantized fallback (mistral-7b-quant).
- Autoscale cooldown 90s to avoid thrash.

carmen-se: ballpark perf: tuned batching gives ~1400 tok/s per A100 for short flows; long decode drops to ~550 tok/s. With token mix 2 reserved cover baseline; prewarm slot absorbs long batch startup so 99p stays low.

hannah-sales: pricing ask: what uplift for reserved vs on-demand?

eva-pm: for 12mo commit we can do ~16% discount on GPU hourly and include 150 burst credits (1 credit = 1 GPU-hour). We'll include an optional 1-tier 10% extra discount if they commit to annual billing.

raj-eng: sample autoscale policy snippet to include in handoff (explain in plain text too):
```json
{ "reserved": 3, "prewarm_slots": 1, "scale_triggers": ["rps>10","queue>25","gpu_util>70"], "max_burst": 3, "cooldown_s": 90, "fallback": "mistral-7b-quant", "kv_preload": "top_180" }
```
Note: prewarm_slots pins weights and warms KV prefixes to avoid cold model load.

leo-infra: add to handoff: if spot eviction happens, immediately route new requests to reserved pool and start fallback model in parallel; configure request tagging so latency-sensitive routes prefer reserved GPUs.

hannah-sales: good. Can someone give a quick GPU-hour calc for the quote?

autoscale-bot: calc done:
- Reserved: 3 GPUs * 24h * 30d = 2160 GPU-hours/month.
- Estimated burst usage: average 2 GPUs for 6h/day -> 360h/month.
- Total ~2520 GPU-hours/month. Include 150 burst credits reduces billable burst by 150h.

eva-pm: I'll convert to $ in the quote once we pick per-GPU-hour list price. Hannah, I'll prep two scenarios (expected vs conservative 1.8x burst).

hannah-sales: great — I'll draft the presales handoff with sizing rationale, autoscale snippet, AZ/spot fallback notes, and pricing scenarios. Tagging @carmen-se for runbook and @leo-infra for security/network blurbs. end of thread.
